stem: At Northwind Video, finance merged eight AWS accounts into one organization. They need chargeback by project tag and want commitment discounts isolated per account.

choices.text: Activate cost allocation tags and disable commitment discount sharing for isolated accounts.
Activate cost allocation tags and leave organization discount sharing enabled across all linked accounts.
Create AWS Budgets for each account and leave cost allocation tags inactive.
Use AWS Billing Conductor billing groups and skip cost allocation tag activation.

rationale: Activating cost allocation tags provides project-level attribution in billing data, and turning off discount sharing enforces account-level isolation for commitment benefits. Keeping sharing enabled does not meet the isolation requirement. Budgets provide threshold alerts but do not replace cost allocation tagging for chargeback views. Billing Conductor can model rates, but without active cost allocation tags it does not satisfy the required project-tag breakdown.
